name: Weekly Leave Report
query:
SELECT
    employee_name,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN status = 'On Leave' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'Half Day' THEN 0.5
        ELSE 0
    END)
     AS leave_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(attendance_date, '%%d %%b %%Y') SEPARATOR ', ') AS leave_dates
FROM
    `tabAttendance`
WHERE
    status IN ("Half Day", "On Leave")
    AND docstatus = 1
    AND attendance_date BETWEEN
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 7 DAY)
        AND
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1 DAY)
GROUP BY
    employee
ORDER BY
    employee_name ASC;
